newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle trade inactive - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle trade inactive - USDA.

text.p: Trade was inactive in the Panhandle area early Friday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers not tested.

Feedlots reporting moderate inquiry from buyers; following weekly movement of 29,000 head. The last established price was 65.00 on Thursday in limited test. Today's packer bids are 65.00 with asking prices 66.00-67.00. Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
